Sniper Off Road is an automotive customization shop located at 510 S Martin Luther King Hwy in Lake Charles, Louisiana. We specialize in various customization services for off-road vehicles. The shop is known for providing high-quality work and excellent customer service. We have received positive reviews from customers, highlighting the professionalism and expertise of our owner.

For more details or to inquire about our services, you can contact us at 337-263-3717. Our operating hours are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and we are closed on weekends​.
